character_creation.connections_prompt: Who trusted you with a secret beneath the lighthouse?

classes.name: Tidecaller
classes.site_description: A guide who turns weather, rhythm, and teamwork into calm momentum.

hope_feature.name: Shared Horizon
hope_feature.text: Spend Hope to let an ally nearby move safely before the next danger arrives.

class_features.name: Read the Weather
class_features.text: Once per scene, ask what change in the surroundings is about to matter.

class_features.name: Crew Signal
class_features.text: When an ally follows your plan, mark the moment with a visible signal and gain a small advantage.

background_questions: What promise did you make at the edge of the salt flats?
Which companion taught you to trust an unfamiliar map?

subclasses.name: Harbor Warden
subclasses.site_description: A protector who keeps fragile communities moving through dangerous seasons.

foundation.name: Safe Passage
foundation.text: Create a clear route for your companions through a crowded or unstable place.

specialization.name: Beacon Step
specialization.text: When you reach a threatened ally, they may immediately reposition beside you.

mastery.name: Unbroken Watch
mastery.text: During a rest, your group cannot be surprised while you remain awake and attentive.
